svg.aria-label: Suzent's memory pipeline. Each chat's facts are captured with the words they came from, appended to a dated Markdown log, folded overnight by the organizer into an Obsidian-compatible notebook with a MEMORY.md map, and recalled in every chat by hybrid search over meaning, keywords, recency and importance. Lessons come from failures that were fixed; facts fade instead of being deleted; the search index rebuilds from the files.
